property_summary: For any caller and any value, calling SetMinSum on the correct contract always succeeds (does not revert) and sets MinSum to the provided value; the mutant that leaves the reentrancy lock permanently true causes subsequent SetMinSum calls to revert (fail) for some inputs (e.g., a second SetMinSum call), breaking this rule.
change_summary: Modify nonReentrant_ modifier to omit setting locked_ back to false after function execution, causing subsequent SetMinSum calls to revert on require and thus changing observed MinSum after calls.
